message.content: In research_summary.md the claim "Fraunhofer’s industry survey reports a weighted average for c‑Si wafer‑based modules near 22–23% in recent quarters" is not tied to a specific dataset version, retrieval date, or reproducible calculation, so we cannot validate or reproduce that 22–23% figure. I would attach the exact Fraunhofer dataset/URL/DOI with retrieval date plus the CSV/JSON snapshot (or a short script showing the weighting calculation) and record that provenance in the summary.
